topic: Redesign UI, meta screen, and audio correction
currentUserGoal: Respond to manual playtest feedback that the redesign still felt poor: wrong/old music, no real game-over/meta screen, tool buttons overlapping HUD text, and the run feed feeling like an obsolete leftover.
changesMade: Converted docs/lucid.aif into a browser-safe WAV at public/assets/music/lucid-field-theme.wav using a local PCM conversion, downmixed to mono 22050 Hz to keep the asset around 8.3 MB.
Changed RedesignPrototypeScene to load and play redesign-lucid-theme instead of the old epic_menu_theme_mellow.wav.
Increased the prototype HUD height and moved Dew Pulse and Root Salve onto a dedicated tool row below the Run Touch readout, fixing the overlap seen in the user's screenshot.
Shortened the Run Touch HUD copy to RT/Earned/GT so it has less chance to collide with action buttons.
Hid the old Run Feed panel from the main play layout. Feed entries still exist internally, but the panel is no longer a player-facing surface.
Recast HP collapse as a full-screen Game Over: Dormancy meta screen with a dark backdrop, run summary, permanent GT gained, and visible skill tree memory buttons.
Changed dormant interaction so clicks inside the meta panel do not immediately restart the run; clicking outside the panel starts the next run.
Added feedPanelVisible and metaScreenVisible to the browser debug payload.
Updated CORE_MECHANICS_REDESIGN.md and CORE_MECHANICS_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md with the UI/audio/meta corrections and smoke expectations.
verification: npm run check passed after the scene and audio changes: ESLint passed, Vitest passed with 2 files and 22 tests, TypeScript compiled, and Vite built successfully.
Browser smoke on http://127.0.0.1:5173/?redesign&resetMemory&fastDormancy&uiCorrectionSmoke=... confirmed the route booted and the first real root click woke the run.
Browser smoke confirmed no warn/error logs after the Lucid WAV started from a user click.
Browser smoke confirmed feedPanelVisible was false.
Browser smoke confirmed Dew Pulse and Root Salve shared a separated tool row at y=200 and no longer occupied the old Run Touch text row.
Browser smoke confirmed HP collapse reached phase dormant with metaScreenVisible and summaryVisible true.
Browser smoke confirmed memory upgrade buttons were visible on the meta screen.
Browser smoke confirmed clicking inside the meta panel kept the run dormant, while clicking outside the panel started the next run.
Browser warn/error logs were empty during the UI/meta/audio smoke.

knownIssues: There is still no options/settings menu. The user called that out but accepted it as likely later work.
The meta screen is still an early prototype: only Soft Touch and Deeper Roots exist as memory buttons, not a proper full skill tree layout.
The Lucid track conversion is a pragmatic local WAV conversion, not a final mastered web audio pipeline.
The old game still exists on the default route and obsolete stress routes; use ?redesign for the new mechanics work.
The redesign route is more coherent after this slice, but it still is not a presentable game yet.
nextRecommendedSteps: Manually play http://127.0.0.1:5173/?redesign&resetMemory and judge whether the new HUD row, hidden feed, Lucid music, and Game Over: Dormancy screen address the immediate playtest complaints.
Design the actual meta skill tree screen instead of the current two-button placeholder.
Add an options/settings surface after the main loop and meta loop feel stable, especially audio volume/mute now that the Lucid track is wired.
Decide whether a dedicated Begin Next Run button should replace the current click-outside-panel restart interaction.
If the corrected loop feels understandable, implement Tiny Sprinkler as the first true run-resetting automation.
doNotRevert: Do not restore the old epic_menu_theme_mellow.wav on the redesign route unless the user explicitly asks.
Do not show the old Run Feed panel as a main play surface without a deliberate redesign.
Do not move run-tool buttons back onto the same row as Run Touch text.
Do not turn HP collapse back into a small overlay on top of active gameplay; the user wants a real game-over/meta screen.
Do not put Sensi back into the player profile/PFP panel in any viewport.
Do not use the obsolete ?stress route as evidence of redesign progress.
